build_param2moe_causal_lm: build a vLLM-native Param2MoE CausalLM model with GQA and sigmoid-scored grouped-topk MoE
create_gqa_attention_layer: create a Grouped-Query Attention layer with optional per-head RMS norms and RoPE embeddings
create_moe_block: create a Mixture-of-Experts block with sigmoid routing, grouped top-k selection, and shared experts
build_decoder_layer: build a transformer decoder layer that switches from dense MLP to MoE after first_k_dense_replace
load_param2moe_weights: load HuggingFace Param2MoE weights into vLLM with QKV split, gate_up stacking, and expert mapping
